events.title: El Tour de Tucson - Sat Nov 21, 7am
events.detail: Expect road closures and delays. Cushing St is closed Fri and Sat. I-10/6th Ave ramp closed 10am-5pm and I-19/Continental closed 8:30am-2pm on Saturday.

events.title: Motorcycle Parts Swap Meet - Sun Nov 29, 10am-2pm
events.detail: Superstition Harley-Davidson, 2910 W Apache Trail, Apache Junction. Free to sell, reserve a spot at 480-346-0600.

events.title: Troll's Teddy Bear Run - Sat Dec 5, sign-in 9-10:30am
events.detail: Poker run starting at Superstition Harley-Davidson, Apache Junction. Expect lots of motorcycle traffic.

events.title: Windy Point group ride - Sun Dec 6, meet 8am
events.detail: Sportbike Riders of Tucson. Meet at Gear Shifters AZ, 1045 N Catalina Ave, Tucson; kickstands up 8:30. Ask to join on Meetup.

events.title: XCEL Motorcycle Trackday - Sun Dec 6, 9am-5pm
events.detail: Track day at Firebird Motorsports Park, Chandler.

events.title: Cycle Gear Bike Night - Tue Dec 8, 5pm
events.detail: Tucson riders meet-up at Cycle Gear, 5385 E Broadway.

events.title: Soldado Christmas Toy Drive - Sat Dec 12, 12-6pm
events.detail: Free. Bring a new toy. Superstition Harley-Davidson, Apache Junction.

events.title: Red Sleigh Toy Run - Sat Dec 19, 8am
events.detail: 20th annual Christmas toy run. Starts at American Legion #36, 5845 E 22nd St, Tucson.

events.title: Arizona Bike Week - Mar 31 to Apr 4, 2027
events.detail: 30th anniversary at WestWorld of Scottsdale. Expect heavy motorcycle traffic around Scottsdale.
